name: Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task
query:
// Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task (T1053.005)
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue has_any ("Scheduled Task")
| where TimeGenerated > ago(5m)
| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Caller, ResourceGroup
| where count_ > 5
